description: Task ontology for V2.2 household service planning. Online perception detects AI2-THOR household object labels, then maps them to task semantics used by the runner.

v2_scope.reason: This ontology is intentionally restricted to object types confirmed in the current AI2-THOR backend coverage check. Removed classes such as Sofa, Bed, Chair, RemoteControl and CoffeeTable will be added later after adding living-room or bedroom benchmark scenarios.
v2_scope.main_task: active household service planning with pickup/place/clean as skills

notes: AI2-THOR metadata may be used offline to generate labels and benchmark scenarios.
Online Agent decisions must use RGB-derived perception plus sanitized action feedback only.
Clean remains available as a service skill, but pickup/place is the V2.2 main service task.
Bowl and Plate can be dual-role objects in AI2-THOR, but the initial runner should use the simplified task_class_map to avoid ambiguous decisions.
